mac_preimage: ASCII spine.trusted-web-cursor.v2 followed by one NUL byte followed by the exact payload bytes
key: Deployment-local random secret of at least 32 bytes, never client/model controlled or emitted; separate from public fixture key. Rotation invalidates old cursors.
decode: Reject token over 8192 ASCII bytes, padding, non-base64url alphabet, noncanonical base64url, noncanonical payload bytes, duplicate JSON keys, unknown fields, invalid payload schema, wrong version, and non-constant-time MAC verification failure. Verify MAC before parsing trusted fields. Do not release payload or parse details in errors.
expiry: issued_at <= now < expires_at <= issued_at + 900 seconds; all child pages preserve original issued_at/expires_at; now must also precede non-null authorization_valid_until_utc. No future-issued cursor.
snapshot: Private revalidation proof covers required temporal sources and all authorized candidates/sections used, including gained visibility and timed grant transitions. Public digest uses only authorized facts; no hidden object identifiers even hashed.
no_durable_state: No cursor/session expansion cache in the ledger, command receipts, provenance or reconciliation writes.

identity_encoding.account_subject_binding_revision: Decimal encoding of the selected account_subject_bindings.revision; not a temporal-binding revision.

subject_revision.preimage: {contract_version: preimage_contract, subject: selected subject closed canonical row}
subject_revision.encoding: 1 + unsigned big-endian integer value of SHA-256(Spine canonical JSON UTF-8 preimage), encoded as unpadded positive decimal.
subject_revision.semantics: Equality token, not a monotonic counter or persisted subject revision. Only the selected subject participates; private release proofs additionally compare its full canonical row.

private_continuation_proofs.storage: Service-local volatile memory only; no response assemblies or durable cursor/session cache. Reassemble and freshly reauthorize every page.
private_continuation_proofs.family_key: SHA-256 of canonical cursor payload with stream and last_key omitted. Never overwrite a different private proof for the same family.
private_continuation_proofs.bounds: At most 128 families and 8388608 serialized private-proof bytes per service instance; deployments may lower both. Prune at fixed expiry or earlier authorization deadline. Do not evict live families to admit new ones; exhaustion is capacity_exceeded.
private_continuation_proofs.loss: Missing private proof is access_changed and requires a fresh query. Process restart loses proofs; key rotation invalidates signatures. No stateless continuation fallback.
private_continuation_proofs.child_pages: Preserve the original family and private authorization evaluation time; do not renew retention or expiry.
